rules.name: Verminous Haze
rules.effect: In the **Declare Battle Formations** step, you can select up to two friendly **PLAGUE MARINES** units. Those units have **Infiltrators**.

stratagems.name: Nauseating Paroxysms
stratagems.cond: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
stratagems.summary: Select engaged enemy unit; it makes battle-shock roll at -1.

stratagems.name: Droning Horror
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.cond: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Can re-roll hit rolls of 1. That target a unit within half range, can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll hit rolls of 1; re-roll wound rolls of 1 against targets within half range.

stratagems.name: Eye of the Swarm
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.cond: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
stratagems.summary: Grant [CLOSE-QUARTERS] to unit's ranged attacks.

rules.name: Worldblight
rules.effect: At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. Until you lose control of that objective, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

stratagems.name: Putrid Detonation
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.summary: Model's Deadly Demise inflicts mortal wounds automatically; affected enemy units become Afflicted until your next turn.

stratagems.name: Disgustingly Resilient
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.summary: Subtract 1 from Damage of all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Plaguesurge
stratagems.cond: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
stratagems.summary: +3" to Contagion Range until start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Leechspore Eruption
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
stratagems.summary: Roll D6s equal to wounds lost (max 6): each 5+ deals 1 mortal wound to nearby enemy unit and heals 1 wound on your model (max 6 each).

stratagems.name: Overwhelming Generosity
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
stratagems.summary: DEATH GUARD units re-roll attack count dice against selected enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Creeping Blight
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit and Wound rolls against Afflicted units this phase.

stratagems.name: Putrid Detonation
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.summary: Model's Deadly Demise inflicts mortal wounds automatically; affected enemy units become Afflicted until your next turn.

enhancements.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle
enhancements.effect: Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Furnace of Plagues
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons, and the bearer's melee weapons have the Devastating Wounds abilty.

enhancements.name: Revolting Regeneration
enhancements.effect: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Arch Contaminator
enhancements.effect: While the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

rules.name: Numberless Horde
rules.effect:
In your Command phase in each of the following battle rounds, depending on your chosen battle size, add a new ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit with a Starting Strength of 10 to your army, in Strategic Reserves.

Incursion - Battle Rounds 2,3
Strike Force - Battle Rounds 2,3,4
Onslaught - Battle Round 2,3,4,5

^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit from your army gain the ^^**Battleline**^^ keyword.

stratagems.name: Grip of the Walking Pox
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.
stratagems.summary: After your unit fights: roll D6 per destroyed model, 6s inflict 1 mortal wound on attackers. If your unit survives, enemy models killed by this Stratagem count as killed by your unit for Curse of the Walking Pox.

stratagems.name: Smeared with Filth
stratagems.cond: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.summary: Select enemy unit that attacked yours; it gains Afflicted until end of battle.

stratagems.name: Gnawing Hunger
stratagems.cond: One POXWALKERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.summary: +1 Move; melee weapons +1 Attacks and Strength.

stratagems.name: Hidden Amongst the Dead
stratagems.timing: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.
stratagems.summary: Models gain Deep Strike ability.

stratagems.name: Shock and Horror
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.cond: That DEATH GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units in Engagement Range take Battle-shock test at -1.

stratagems.name: Shambling Wall
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.
stratagems.summary: POXWALKERS take allocated attacks instead; absorb damage by losing models equal to attack's Damage.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Walking Pox
enhancements.effect: If the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.

enhancements.name: Talisman of Burgeoning
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Witherbone Pipes
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.

enhancements.name: Sorrowsyphon
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer's unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer's unit are destroyed.

rules.name: Deadly Vectors
rules.effect: In your opponent's Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit, subtracting 1 from the result if that unit is Below Half-strength. If the result is 6 or less, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Blooming Pestilence
stratagems.cond: One TERMINATOR unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.
stratagems.summary: +3" to Contagion Range.

stratagems.name: Grim Reapers
stratagems.cond: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls against non-MONSTER, non-VEHICLE units.

stratagems.name: Undying Spite
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed models that haven't fought this phase: roll D6, on 4+ fight before removal.

stratagems.name: Signal Pox
stratagems.cond: One LORD OF VIRULENCE model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.summary: Select objective within 30" and visible to your model; enemy units within range become Afflicted until your next turn starts.

stratagems.name: Mortarion's Teachings
stratagems.cond: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.
stratagems.summary: Grant [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Sickening Impact
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.cond: That TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.summary: Roll D6 for each model in Engagement Range (max 6); each 2+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on target enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Face of Death
enhancements.effect: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Vile Vigour
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristics of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Warprot Talisman
enhancements.effect: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battle field and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Helm of the Fly King
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

rules.name: Miasmic Bombardment
rules.effect:
At the start of the battle round, select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model in your army that is on the battle field. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

Incursion - 1 Unit
Strike Force - 2 Units
Onslaught - 3 Units

stratagems.name: Blighted Land
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units within 3" of selected terrain feature are Afflicted until your next turn.

stratagems.name: Relentless Grind
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.summary: Move through terrain horizontally.

stratagems.name: Drawn to Despair
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls against visible enemies in opponent's deployment zone (excluding AIRCRAFT).

stratagems.name: Font of Filth
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [ASSAULT] to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Eyestinger Storm
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
stratagems.summary: Select visible objective. Afflicted enemies in range take Battle-shock test; blocks further tests that phase.

stratagems.name: Stinking Mire
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
stratagems.summary: -1 to charge rolls for selected enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Eye of Affliction
enhancements.effect: Ranged weapons equipped by model's in the bearer's unit have the [Ignores Cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Bilemaw Blight
enhancements.effect: At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon.

enhancements.name: Shriekworm Familiar
enhancements.effect: Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Tendrilous Emissions
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly ^^**Death Guard Vehicle**^^ units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those ^^**Vehicle**^^ units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Manifold Maladies
rules.effect: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle's Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.

stratagems.name: Blessings of Filth
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.summary: Grant [CRITICAL HITS] on unmodified 5+ to unit's attacks.

stratagems.name: Malignance Magnified
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit and Wound rolls against units below Starting Strength.

stratagems.name: Grotesque Fortitude
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.summary: +2 Toughness to unit until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Rabid Infusion
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.summary: Fights First until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Mobile Vector
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
stratagems.summary: Attach your DEATH GUARD CHARACTER as Leader to friendly unit within 2" horizontal/5" vertical; update Starting Strength.

stratagems.name: Death’s Heads
stratagems.cond: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).
stratagems.summary: Enemy non-VEHICLE unit within 8" gains all Plague effects until your next turn.

enhancements.name: Final Ingredient
enhancements.effect: Once per battle, after the bearer's unit has fought, if one or more ^^**Character**^^ models were destroyed by those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, if an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

enhancements.name: Visions of Virulence
enhancements.effect: While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer's Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.

enhancements.name: Needle of Nurgle
enhancements.effect: Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer's unit (instead of 1).

enhancements.name: Cornucophagus
enhancements.effect: In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

rules.name: Reverberant Rancidity
rules.effect:
While a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit from your army is within 7" of one or more ^^**Death Guard^^** units from your army, that ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit has the Nurgle's Gift ability.

While a ^^**Death Guard^^** unit from your army is within 7" of one or more ^^**Plague Legions^^** units from your army, add 3" to that ^^**Death Guard^^** unit's Contagion Range.

stratagems.name: Persistent Pests
stratagems.cond: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.summary: Restore destroyed unit to Strategic Reserves at full strength and wounds.

stratagems.name: Clutching Corruption
stratagems.cond: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls against units in Engagement Range of friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS units.

stratagems.name: All Is Rot
stratagems.cond: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units not in Engagement Range for your ranged attacks; enemy units within Engagement Range that lose wounds: roll D6 per wound lost, 5+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on your unit.

stratagems.name: Fleshy Avalanche
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One PLAGUE LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.summary: Move through terrain horizontally.

stratagems.name: Avatars of Decay
stratagems.cond: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units within 6" gain Afflicted.

stratagems.name: Mireslick
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.cond: One PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.
stratagems.summary: Enemy within Engagement Range must pass Leadership test to Fall Back or Remain Stationary.

enhancements.name: Beckoning Blight
enhancements.effect: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit from your army is set up on the battle field using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from any enemy models, instead of more than 8".

enhancements.name: Fell Harvester
enhancements.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Entropic Knell
enhancements.effect: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

enhancements.name: Tome of Bounteous Blessings
enhancements.effect: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a ^^**Battleline^^** unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).

rules.name: Warped and Rusted Animus
rules.effect:
Friendly FOETID BLOAT‑DRONE/FOETID BLOAT‑DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER/HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT‑HAULER units have CONTAGION ENGINE. 
- Friendly CONTAGION ENGINE units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: Fresh Vectors
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.cond: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Bloodrust Deluge
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.cond: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.
stratagems.summary: Enemy unit Afflicted until your unit attacks.

stratagems.name: Soulrot Flux
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.cond: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, roll one D6: On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Enemy unit falling back from you takes 1 MW (1), D3 MW (2-5), or 3 MW (6).

rules.name: Hypervirulent Strains
rules.effect: Friendly **DEATH GUARD CHARACTER** units have +3" to their **Contagion Range** (to a maximum of 12").

stratagems.name: Territorial Infection
stratagems.cond: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
stratagems.summary: +1 OC until end of turn.

glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[RAPID FIRE X]**. Each time you gather **attack dice** for a **[RAPID FIRE]** weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step. 
***Example:** If a **[RAPID FIRE 1]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Pistol
glossary.effect:
**[PISTOL]** and **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** are identical for all rules purposes. 

Units containing one or more models with a **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapon can shoot using **close-quarters shooting** (10.06). When using another **shooting type**, for each model in that unit (excluding **MONSTER/VEHICLE** models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with: 
- One or more of its **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapons. 
- One or more of its other ranged weapons.

glossary.name: Hazardous
glossary.effect: Each time a unit is **selected to shoot** or **selected to fight**, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make a number of **hazard rolls** (06.03) for that unit equal to the number of **[HAZARDOUS]** weapons you selected in the Select Weapons step.

glossary.name: Anti
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[ANTI-X Y+]**. Each time an attack is made with an **[ANTI]** weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by **X**, an unmodified **wound roll** of **Y+** is a **critical wound**.
***Example:** An attack made with an **[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]** weapon against a ^^**Vehicle**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 4+, while an attack made with an **[ANTI-PSYKER 2+]** weapon against a ^^**Psyker**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 2+.*

glossary.name: Devastating Wounds
glossary.effect:
Each time an attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon results in a **critical wound**, the attack sequence for that attack ends and the target unit suffers a number of **mortal wounds** equal to the **D** characteristic of that weapon. These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. 
**Mortal wounds** inflicted by **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each **critical wound**; any remaining **mortal wounds** inflicted by that attack are lost. 
***Example:** An attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of 3 results in a **critical wound** against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 **mortal wounds**. The first 2 **mortal wounds** are sufficient to **destroy** 1 Intercessor model, so the remaining **mortal wound** is lost.*

glossary.name: Torrent
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TORRENT]** weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

glossary.name: Ignores Cover
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with an **[IGNORES COVER]** weapon, the target cannot have the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08), including from rules that give a model or unit the **benefit of cover** (e.g. **Stealth**).

glossary.name: Psychic
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[PSYCHIC]** weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s **BS** or **WS** characteristic and any or all modifiers to the **hit roll**. Attacks made with **[PSYCHIC]** weapons are known as **psychic attacks** (this can be important for the triggering of other rules).

glossary.name: Blast
glossary.effect:
Each time you gather attack dice for a **[BLAST]** weapon, add one additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form **[BLAST X]**, each time you gather **attack dice** for such a weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. 
***Example:** If a **[BLAST 2]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Melta
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[MELTA X]**. Each time a model makes an attack with a **[MELTA]** weapon, if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step, until the attacking unit’s attacks have been resolved, add **X** to that weapon’s **D** characteristic. 
***Example:** A model targets a unit that is within half range of a **[MELTA 2]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of D6. While resolving those attacks, that weapon has a **D** characteristic of **D6+2**.*

glossary.name: Scouts
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Scouts X"**. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: 
- If that unit is in **strategic reserves**, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone. 
- If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a **scout move**. 
- If that unit is embarked within a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** has the Scouts ability, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** can make a **scout move**.

glossary.name: Feel No Pain
glossary.effect: This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

glossary.name: Infiltrators
glossary.effect: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

glossary.name: Assault
glossary.effect: Units containing one or more models with an **[ASSAULT]** weapon can shoot using **assault shooting** (10.05).

glossary.name: Precision
glossary.effect: While resolving attacks made with one or more **[PRECISION]** weapons, at the start of the Allocation Order step (05.03), if the target unit contains one or more **CHARACTER** models **visible** to one or more of the attacking models, the active player can select one allocation group that contains one of those **visible CHARACTER** models. If they do, until those attacks are resolved, or until that **CHARACTER** group is **destroyed** (whichever happens first), that **CHARACTER** group is the current allocation group.

glossary.name: Sustained Hits
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

glossary.name: Indirect Fire
glossary.effect: Units containing one or more models with an **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapon can shoot using indirect shooting (10.07).

glossary.name: Extra Attacks
glossary.effect:
Each time a unit containing one or more models with an **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon fights, those models will make attacks with those weapons in addition to any others. In the Select Weapons step (04.01), for each of those models, you must select: 
- All of that model’s **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapons. 
- One of that model’s other melee weapons, if possible.

glossary.name: Firing Deck
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Firing Deck X**. In your Shooting phase, each time this **TRANSPORT** is **selected to shoot**, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence: 
1. Select up to **X** models embarked within this **TRANSPORT** (excluding models whose units have already been **selected to shoot** this phase). 
2. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding **[ONE SHOT]** weapons). 
3. Until this **TRANSPORT** has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. 
4. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this **TRANSPORT** are not eligible to shoot.

glossary.name: One Shot
glossary.effect:
Each weapon with this ability can only be selected to make attacks with once per battle. 
If a **destroyed** model is returned to a unit, all of its **[ONE SHOT]** weapons that have already been selected to make attacks with during the battle cannot be selected to make attacks with again. 
If a new unit is added to an army, all **[ONE SHOT]** weapons in that unit can be selected to make attacks with once per battle.

glossary.name: Heavy
glossary.effect:
In your Shooting phase, each time an attack is made with a **[HEAVY]** weapon, add 1 to the **hit roll** if all of the following apply to the attacking unit: 
- That unit is **unengaged**. 
- That unit was not set up on the battlefield this turn. 
- No model in that unit has moved more than 3" this turn.

glossary.name: Conversion
glossary.effect: Each time an attack made with this weapon targets a unit more than 12" from the bearer, an unmodified successful Hit roll of 4+ scores a Critical Hit.

glossary.name: Hover
glossary.effect: Each time this unit **takes to the skies** (21.03), do not subtract 2" from the **maximum distance**.

glossary.name: Lance
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[LANCE]** weapon, if the attacking model’s unit made a **charge move** this turn, add 1 to the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: Super-Heavy Walker
glossary.effect:
Each time a unit with this ability makes a **normal**, **advance** or **fall-back move**: 
- Models in that unit can move through models (including **MONSTER/VEHICLE** models, but excluding **TITANIC** models) and can move horizontally through sections of **terrain features** that are 4" or less in height. 
- Before moving that unit, you can select for all models in that unit to have the **MOBILE** keyword until that move ends. If you do, when that move ends, roll one D6: on a 1, that unit is battle-shocked. 
***Designer’s Note:** Gaining the **MOBILE** keyword for the duration of a move will enable models in that unit to move horizontally through **dense terrain features** (13.06).*
